system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Prompt Generator rewrites `prompt.txt`, next run picks it up automatically.
system_prompt_style.note: Default mode skill_only keeps a static prompt.txt read from disk; prompt_only mode lets a Prompt Generator model rewrite it. Skills are loaded via setting_sources, which also suggests dynamic composition.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Read, Write, Bash, Glob, Grep, Edit, WebFetch, WebSearch, TodoWrite, BashOutput, Skill
env_context_strategy.note: Worker agents navigate with the tools of the wrapped harness (Claude Code by default).

context_compaction.note: Compaction is delegated to the wrapped agent SDK; the evidence does not describe it.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calls are made through the Claude Code SDK by default.

tool_count.evidence_quote: **Full toolbox (11 tools)** — used by worker agents + skill generator:
tool_count.note: Proposers and the prompt generator get a read-only set of 8 tools.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Read, Write, Bash, Glob, Grep, Edit, WebFetch, WebSearch, TodoWrite, BashOutput, Skill
edit_primitive.note: Inferred from Claude Code Edit/Write tool names; their semantics are not shown in the evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If score improved → keep it! Save it as a git branch.
loop_primitives.note: The outer loop evolves programs using feedback descent over a frontier. Inner agents are ReAct-style SDK agents.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Read, Write, Bash, Glob, Grep, Edit, WebFetch, WebSearch, TodoWrite, BashOutput, Skill
planning_granularity.note: A TodoWrite tool is available, but the evidence does not show a plan object that the harness stores.

multi_agent_topology.note: The fixed hand-off sequence is Base Agent -> Proposer -> Generator -> Evaluator.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: This is passed to `Agent(options=factory, ...)`. Agent calls `factory()` on every `.run()`, giving fresh options each time.
delegation_mechanism.note: Each role runs as a new agent run created by the loop, not by an agent-invoked tool.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The loop maintains a fixed-capacity frontierGof thekhighest-scoring programs.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: `.claude/feedback_history.md` records what the proposer tried each iteration and why it succeeded or failed.
long_term_memory.note: Skills in .claude/skills/ persist and are loaded on later runs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: `--continue` | Resume from the existing frontier instead of starting fresh.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Scores the new program variant on a held-out validation set to measure improvement.
self_verification.note: The default scorer is multi_tolerance. llm, script and harbor verifier scorers are selectable in config.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If the SDK fails, it retries 3 times with increasing delays (30s, 60s, 120s)
retry_policy.note: This is an SDK transport retry. The evolution loop instead iterates up to 20 times, and each task is attempted once per evaluation. Arguably none.

rollback.evidence_quote: EvoSkill uses your repo's git history to version every program it creates.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If nothing has improved for 5 iterations → stop, we're stuck
termination_condition.note: The loop runs at most 20 iterations by default.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Avoids re-running the same question if nothing changed.

timeouts.note: The limit applies per agent call. Daytona has an optional auto-stop timeout.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Execution mode** — Local (direct), Docker (containerized, supports remote via `DOCKER_HOST`), or Daytona (managed cloud sandbox).
execution_isolation.note: Local is the default. Docker and Daytona are selectable; Harbor uses containers.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: extra directories the agent can read

network_policy.evidence_quote: Read, Write, Bash, Glob, Grep, Edit, WebFetch, WebSearch, TodoWrite, BashOutput, Skill

permission_model.evidence_quote: Key difference: no `Write`, `Edit`, or `Skill`. Proposers can only analyze, not modify files.
permission_model.note: Tool lists are fixed per role. Workers use acceptEdits.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `evoskill eval` | Evaluate the best program on the validation set

guardrails.evidence_quote: Proposers are read-only on purpose. No Write or Edit tools.

target_domain.evidence_quote: EvoSkill: Automated Skill Discovery for Coding Agents
target_domain.note: The evaluated benchmarks are QA and search tasks.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: you are free to use any model provider of your choice
model_agnostic.note: The default claude harness is Anthropic-only.
